target.artifact: recovery-generation exclusive fence and durable collision receipt
target.consumer: universal worker stale/retry executor and stress verifier

title: Fence concurrent recovery writers
problem: Live evidence on 2026-09-17 showed two workers independently recover the same stale Prometeo-mobile PLAN lane. Both observed the same prior stale recovery state, wrote separate append-only recovery claims six seconds apart, and both crossed into STARTED with overlapping write scopes. This is a TOCTOU gap: pre-claim overlap checks and append-only recovery history preserve evidence but do not atomically choose one substantive recovery writer.
mission: Extend the existing lease/retry recovery fabric so same-generation recovery contenders for one opportunity and overlapping write scope elect exactly one substantive writer, while losers persist durable collision/boundary evidence and immediately re-enter allocation without deleting or overwriting any attempt.
acceptance: A recovery generation has a reconstructable identity derived from the original opportunity plus latest durable recovery signal/attempt lineage.
For one generation and overlapping write scope, at most one contender crosses the substantive STARTED/writer gate.
Atomic create-if-absent/CAS or an equivalent deterministic post-claim election establishes the winner; recency alone is never authority.
Every loser persists an append-only RECOVERY_COLLISION or BOUNDARY receipt linking the winner it yielded to, then re-enters allocation.
If a second contender already wrote STARTED before seeing the winner, it must yield before any substantive target write and record that fact durably.
Independent opportunities and provably non-overlapping isolated candidate scopes retain parallelism.
Late original returns and prior recovery outputs remain preserved for Steward/validator reconciliation.
A fixture or live race with at least two simultaneous recovery contenders demonstrates exactly one substantive writer and durable loser evidence.

observed_live_evidence.finding: Both attempts reached STARTED; therefore pre-claim no-overlap checks alone are insufficient under concurrent recovery acquisition.

value_signals.unblock_value: Prevents recovery itself from creating duplicate active writers on lanes whose recovery is intended to remove stale gates.
value_signals.compounding_value: Every future stale recovery benefits; contention safety improves as identical-worker count rises rather than degrading with more workers.
value_signals.human_friction_reduction: Workers can resolve recovery collisions durably without the human deciding which recovery chat should continue.
value_signals.information_gain: Durable winner/loser receipts turn recovery contention into measurable canary evidence instead of invisible timing behavior.

risk.main: An over-broad fence could serialize safe independent recovery work.
risk.mitigation: Key exclusivity to recovery generation + overlapping substantive write scope, not to all RECOVER work or all attempts for an opportunity forever.

falsification: Two same-generation recovery contenders with overlapping scope both perform substantive target writes.
A loser cannot identify the durable winning recovery attempt it yielded to.
The fence blocks recovery of a different opportunity or a provably isolated non-overlapping candidate scope.
Winner selection depends on newest timestamp rather than an atomic/deterministic authority rule.
Late original RETURN is discarded or overwritten because a recovery fence exists.
dedup_note: This is not the existing normal claim-attempt receipt proposal: that proposal instruments ordinary create-if-absent claim outcomes. It is also not a reimplementation of stale detection/CAS. The new gap is specifically recovery-generation writer election after two append-only recovery contenders both passed preflight and reached STARTED.

source_freshness.note: Runtime projection lagged the live main head during discovery; the race evidence paths were fetched directly from main.
